recommendation_summary: Set up one externally hosted heartbeat monitor that the nightly-sync script pings after each successful run, which emails the user if no ping arrives after 03:00 plus a grace period, and test it by deliberately missing a heartbeat.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want an alert when `nightly-sync` fails, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker from this fix; neither is needed to detect a missed run.
labels.Bottleneck: The job sends its own email, so a startup crash also disables its notification.
labels.Checked myself: Nothing directly; your account establishes four missed runs and no independent alert.

note: The reply recommends a single external dead-man heartbeat, explicitly drops central logging and Docker, and its Checked myself line plainly says nothing was checked.
